items.Sentence: Primary treatment consists of 2-millimeter (mm) drum screens with a bypass channel/bar with screens
Each bioreactor train consists of two anoxic zones followed by one aerobic zone
Flow from the aerobic zone is pumped to the membrane filtration units, which provide tertiary treatment
The tertiary-treated effluent is disinfected using an ultraviolet light (UV) disinfection system
the reduced solids are purged into the digester, which holds the solids for 10 to 15 days
the solids are sent to dewatering equipment, which includes a centrifuge
The dewatered biosolids are hauled off-site to the Clovis Municipal Solid Waste Landfill
As a backup option, the biosolids could be hauled to a Class B Solids land application facility
